raw_text: Forclaz Travel 500 Organizer 40 L Backpack by Decathlon. Designed for backpacking trips, engineered to be repairable. Price: €89.99. Weight: 1.7 kg. Capacity: 40 liters. Dimensions: 55 x 35 x 25 cm — accepted as cabin baggage on many airlines (check your airline's limits). Carrying system: foam back panel with ventilation channels, padded adjustable shoulder straps and a removable waist belt for load support on transfer days. Full-front opening: the main compartment unzips fully like a suitcase for easy packing, with an internal divider, two zipped mesh pockets, a separate bottom shoe/laundry compartment and side water-bottle pockets. Lockable double sliders on the main zip. Main fabric made from 100% recycled polyester. 10-year warranty; spare parts (buckles, straps) available and repairable in Decathlon workshops. Tested in real conditions by our trekking design teams in the French Alps.
